description.value: Farmstrong Cider Company is a family-run craft cidery and farm restaurant operating out of a restored heritage barn on a century-old farm in Armstrong, BC's Okanagan Valley. Small-batch ciders are made on-site from locally sourced fruit, with guided cellar tours and tasting flights available. Touring cyclists can stop for a full lunch or dinner menu featuring wood-fired pizza, with outdoor seating and a dog-friendly patio.
